seo_description: College scholarships for international students in the USA. Compare award ranges, deadlines, and requirements, then apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to find college scholarships in the USA for international students usually means sorting through very different rules, study levels, and subject areas without wasting time on poor matches. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to that search, with programs that can touch areas such as education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and more. As you compare the rows below, expect variation in award amounts, deadline timing, essay expectations, and eligibility details. Some listings may fit graduate study, while others may be better for high school seniors or current college students. If you plan to apply in the USA, it is worth checking the dates promptly because deadlines differ by program and some opportunities can close sooner than expected.
